name: ic-datasheet
title_zh: A4 纸面级 Verilog 工程数据手册
tagline_zh: 别人交 PPT 你交纸——模块符号、引脚表、互联框图、时序波形、寄存器地图，一页页像 ARM 原厂手册。
tagline_en: While others hand over slides, you hand over paper—module symbols, pin tables, block diagrams, timing waveforms.
desc_en: Use when the user asks for a datasheet, spec sheet, or design manual for a Verilog/SystemVerilog project - a printable A4 document with module symbols, pin tables, a connectivity block diagram, timing waveforms and a register map, in the style of a foundry IP datasheet (ARM Artisan memory compiler). Distinct from a screen-oriented HTML design document; this one produces a print-oriented datasheet.
why_zh: 它把设计文档从屏幕导向掰成打印导向：不是网页长卷，而是按 A4 分页、带图框编号的硬核规格书。
why_en: It flips design docs from screen-first to print-first: A4-paginated, framed, numbered—a hardcopy spec that wins trust the moment.
limit_zh: 只认 Verilog/SystemVerilog 工程；不产出 PDF。
limit_en: Verilog/SystemVerilog only; outputs printable A4 layout source (HTML/LaTeX), not PDF. Timing waveforms require existing constraints or stimuli—it.
title_en: Print-ready A4 datasheet for Verilog projects, foundry-style
